#Poisson of Species Dataset
> library(readr)
> species <- read_csv("species.csv")

dbl (2): Biomass, Species

#Creation of all possible model combinations:
> mod_intercept <- lm(species$Species~1)
> mod1 <- lm(species$Species~species$pH, data = species)
> mod2 <- lm(species$Species~species$Biomass, data = species)
> mod3 <- lm(species$Species~species$pH*species$Biomass, data = species)
> mod4 <- lm(species$Species~species$pH+species$Biomass, data = species)

#Model Selection:
#First load the package AICcmodavg
> library(AICcmodavg)

#AICc:
> AICc(mod_intercept)
[1] 667.1396

> AICc(mod1)
[1] 622.5944

> AICc(mod2)
[1] 659.7421

> AICc(mod3)
[1] 505.7315

> AICc(mod4)      #This has the lowest AICc!
[1] 501.5387

> summary(mod4)

#Poisson GLM:
